IONA, KEEPER OF THE EAST LIGHT

“That is the way home. Look — the ferry is answering. You noticed what the fog tried to hide.”

Iona takes out a letter. “I was afraid every night. I kept the light anyway. You may add it to the harbour record, if you think it would help someone.”

Keep the letter between us.
A private promise. On your next visit, she will offer it freely.
Let the harbour know her name.
With her permission, let her courage become public history.
